title: Five 5-Minute Plays
subtitle: A free printable for ages 0–5: five little plays with things you already have, each with an age ladder, a talk line and a safety line
record_type: free lead magnet (not a listing: never sold, never on Etsy; so it has no listing.json and is not run through check_listings.py, which fails any $0 digital item by design)
activities: 5 plays, 0 things to buy, 0 minutes of prep, about 5 minutes each; a 1-minute version of each

files.source: source.html (color, US Letter); build/build.js holds every word; bash build/make.sh rebuilds and checks

delivery: Only by the email platform, as the link in the welcome email (marketing/email/welcome/01-welcome.md), sent after the double opt-in confirmation. Hosted on the email platform or the site, never on a marketplace.
signup_rules: Adults only: a required, unticked box 'I am the parent or guardian and 18 or older' (business/GROWTH-ENGINE.md §2c; CAMPAIGN-BIBLE COPPA note)
Fields: email (required); child's birth month and year (optional, two dropdowns); nothing else. Never a child's name, photo or full birth date
Double opt-in: nothing is sent until the confirm link is clicked (copy in marketing/email/signup-and-double-opt-in.md)
Privacy policy linked beside the button; CAN-SPAM footer with the business mailing address; one-click unsubscribe
Sign-ups tagged by source (src=bonus-<slug>, src=pin, src=site). Sign-ups from research-hub pages (src=hub) get no product email (BRAND search-targeting rules; founder decision D10)
No ad pixels on the sign-up page; email open tracking off where the platform allows it [UNVERIFIED which platforms allow it]
bonus_urls_served: Every product's playbeforepixels.com/bonus/<slug> page offers this printable (the QR codes in the store editions point there).
alt_text: Cover of the free printable “Five 5-Minute Plays”: a navy title with a tomato-red 5 on a pale green panel, a smiling grown-up and child with a pot and spoon, and five play icons.

compliance_notes: No health or outcome claims (the build fails on milestone, delay, 'falling behind' and 'should'); nothing named; every play has a safety line (blanket play for awake time only and never in a baby's sleep space; cups too big to fit through a toilet-paper tube; cool empty pots away from the stove; closed, locked windows and no climbing; socks with nothing sewn on). No diagnosis or condition wording anywhere. 'Talk, sing and read in the language you know best'; a sign, point or device tap counts. The last page states the privacy promise the sign-up form must keep. No Type 3 fonts; no placeholder text; owner and version line on every page.
